fontLicensePolicy: The existing renamed Source Sans 3 Regular instance is reused unchanged with source and OFL notice retained. The same static font, optical design and weight400 are used in both variants.
mode: Existing generated photographic artwork and paper presentation reused unchanged; native SVG multiline text composed separately. No new image generation.

layout_record.method: Exact fixed-font lines with only word allocation changed. Both variants preserve all logical text, column width, font metrics, tracking/kerning, baseline interval, first baseline and starting edge. The final example begins with measured greedy wrapping and moves two words from the penultimate line to the last.

comparisonPolicy: Only word allocation across 2/2/5 fixed lines changes. Poster moves for to line2; product card moves 320 to join ml; visitor guide moves your booking from line4 to line5. Every word/space, font/size/weight, kerning/tracking, leading, measure, first baseline and left anchor, photo bytes/crops, paper, lighting and unrelated elements remain fixed. The first three visitor-guide lines are unchanged.

verification.textBounds: within the declared paper or phone surface
verification.pixelCheck: Only intended declared line-break intervention regions differ.
verification.scope: Exact DOM normalization permits only tspan word allocation. Logical paragraph text, attributes, size/leading/measure and complete remaining artifact nodes stay identical. All measured/rendered lines fit. Pixel differences in the visitor guide are restricted to the final two lines. Wide/narrow surfaces and SVG-image/inline equality are checked.

limitations: Static English-language editorial examples; not output from Adobe software, implemented nonbreaking-space/automatic balance behavior, a responsive website, measured reader performance, physical print proof or complete accessibility conformance. Before designs remain readable and may serve expressive purposes.
